prompts.prompt: What is the tallest mountain in the world?

The tallest mountain in the world is Mount Everest (also known as K2), located in the Himalayas. This peak stands at an elevation of 8,848 meters (29,029 feet) above sea level.

Mount Everest is not just the highest mountain but also one of the most challenging to climb due to its steep and rocky terrain. Climbing to the summit requires extensive training, equipment, and expertise from experienced mountaineers.
